_comment: You almost certainly do not need this file. Run `graphforge mcp install --client cursor` and it writes .cursor/mcp.json for you, with the console script resolved from the interpreter graphforge is actually installed into rather than whatever `graphforge` happens to mean on PATH. Use this only to merge by hand: copy to .cursor/mcp.json (gitignored) and make both paths absolute. There is no password here on purpose -- --env points at your .env so the secret lives in one place. `python -m graphforge mcp` is the same server if the console script is not on PATH.
